title: Ather Energy's e-scooter sales cross 3 lakh in 2026: 3,01,133 Vahan registrations from 1 Jan to 6 Nov, up 67% YoY; 16.3% e-two-wheeler share, its highest (16.1% in 2025); third behind TVS and Bajaj, ahead of Hero's Vida; best month March (36,630); Autocar India and BikeAdvice expect about 3.5 lakh by year-end
